hazards.location: src/reconstruction/style-generator.ts declarations() (properties emitted in sorted name order)
hazards.detail: `white-space` sorts AFTER `text-wrap-mode` and is a shorthand for white-space-collapse + text-wrap-mode, so the emitted `white-space` wins over the emitted `text-wrap-mode`. This is benign today because the browser's computed `white-space` serialization already reflects the observed text-wrap-mode (a nowrap source computes white-space:nowrap), so the two never disagree. It does mean text-wrap-mode is effectively carried by white-space and text-wrap-style is the load-bearing new property. Named here so a future change to either does not silently break balance.

notes: Darwin-only measurement: every -webkit-font-smoothing assertion is a COMPUTED-VALUE assertion measured on macOS chromium 151. No claim is made about how antialiased renders on any other platform, and no pixel comparison of smoothing was performed.

Pixel assertions were not used for the pseudo cases; per the task brief the computed-style equality between source and clone (case by case, including an ::after channel case) is the proof, plus an explicit over-suppression guard on the fully visible control pseudo.

The fixture pins font-family: monospace so source and clone measure identical glyph metrics; that is what makes the byte-identical line-box comparison meaningful. Fonts themselves remain out of scope.

The suite renders the compiled node tree itself rather than running `next build`: it deliberately does NOT import src/reconstruction/layout-inference.ts, asset-resolver.ts or compile-node.ts, so it stays green independently of the other 28.5B builders working in those files. The class names come from the real styleClassName()/documentRootClassName() and every pseudo selector is asserted against the real pseudoSelector(), so a generator/DOM mismatch fails rather than being papered over.
No git operation was performed. Temp files were written under tmp/wr285b/vocab/ and removed.
residualRisks: Reconstruction QA / interaction target-state QA baselines recorded before this change compared 111 element properties; they now compare 114. Any stored mismatch count is not directly comparable.
text-wrap-mode is effectively overridden by the alphabetically later `white-space` shorthand in generated rules (benign today — see hazards).

Observation payload grows by 3 element properties and 2 pseudo properties per distinct style map; the shared style table absorbs most of this, but token counts may rise slightly where two elements previously deduped and now differ only in a new property.
